main_text.head: Laudando Defendenti.
main_text.l: J ane veni mi chare | R odolphe probato | V irete
O mine felici nunc | O mnia, nil sit | I nultum
H erculeus labor in | D omino sit, tela | R epellat
A tq; bonis avibus sic | O mnes enecet | E nse
N unc cantent magnas | L audes magnosq; | T riumphos
E xclament Musae : | P ulchra est tua fama | V irete :
S ervet te Deus ac | H aec coepta Jehova | S ecundet.
main_text.head: GABRIEL ZEHENDER.
Epi- & Anagrammatismus,
JOHANNES RODOLPHUS GRUENERUS HORRENDAS VULPES URGE O! HIS NON (parcet)
main_text.p: ROscidus hicce RODOLPH virtute virescit in agris, Grandia cum peragit, rore, virore viret: Otia dum vitat, virgulta virida quaerit, Recte facit, studijs invigilare suis Dum cupit, iste studet pretium persolvere Musis Unde venit, GRUNER scandere quod Cathedram Optatam possit, celso de ponte Cathedra Eruit hic hostes, destruit atque fugat. Ludando VULPES HORRENDAS pelle vel URGE, NON parcas, O! HIS, ne capiaris ab his; Praemia sunt praesto certantibus, ac manet ipsos Eximium nomen, gloria, magnus honos. Hoc clarum specimen, quod GRUNER grunet aperte Rem probat esse bonam, nomen & omen adest.

p.i: Hos versus male tornatos modulatus avena Rudolph a Bergen: Floreat, opto, GRUNERI

page.notes: Initial R of the poem is a large woodcut-style letter; the lower verse of the poem appears in a mixed, slightly ragged layout. The last line is partly obscured by show-through and the faint text beneath it is not transcribed. The three-column acrostic is set as three parallel verse columns; line breaks are marked with the column separator.
